## Adversarial Claim Verifier (voter 3/3)

Be SKEPTICAL. Try to REFUTE this claim. ≥2/3 refutations kill it.

## Research question
State of the art (as of July 2026) in AI coding-agent governance and harness design — the problem space of the claude.md-workflow repo: project instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md-style), lifecycle hooks, deterministic verification gates, persistent agent memory/working-state across sessions and compaction, behavioral guardrails against scope creep/overclaiming/sycophancy, git-level enforcement, task contracts, and parallel multi-agent orchestration (worktree isolation, orchestrator/reduce patterns, adversarial review). Survey and compare best practices from: Anthropic (Claude Code, Agent SDK, skills/hooks/subagents), OpenAI (Codex, AGENTS.md), Google (Gemini CLI/Jules/Antigravity), Microsoft (GitHub Copilot agents, AutoGen/agent frameworks), NVIDIA (agent toolkits/NeMo), xAI (Grok agents/coding); and non-Western labs: Moonshot AI (Kimi K2.5 agentic training), Zhipu/Z.ai (GLM-5.x coding agents), DeepSeek (agentic/tool-use practices), Tencent (recent Hunyuan model launch and agent tooling), MiniMax (M-series agentic models), Alibaba Qwen if relevant; plus respected independents: Nous Research (Hermes 4/Hermes agent), Fundamental Research Labs (Peter Wang co-founder), the team behind the Ornith-1.0 LLM, tinygrad/George Hotz's approach to minimal harnesses, and any other influential open agent-harness projects (e.g. OpenHands, SWE-agent, Aider, Cline, Devin/Cognition). For each: what they prescribe for instruction-file structure and length, memory persistence, verification/eval gating, multi-agent patterns, and prompt-vs-deterministic enforcement. Identify convergent consensus, notable divergences (especially Western vs Chinese lab practices), and concrete, citable insights that should shape a 2026 rewrite of a drop-in governance kit for coding agents. Note if any named entity cannot be verified to exist (e.g. 'Ornith-1.0') rather than guessing.

## Claim under review
"Zhipu AI explicitly frames GLM-5 as a paradigm shift from 'vibe coding' to 'agentic engineering', i.e., positioning the model for autonomous end-to-end software engineering rather than interactive assisted coding."

**Source:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15763 (primary)
**Supporting quote:** "We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering."

## Checklist
1. Is the claim actually supported by the quote, or is it an overreach/misread?
2. WebSearch for contradicting evidence — does any credible source dispute or heavily qualify this?
3. Is the source quality sufficient for the claim's strength? (extraordinary claims need primary sources)
4. Is the claim outdated? (check dates — old claims about fast-moving fields are suspect)
5. Is this a marketing claim / press release / cherry-picked benchmark / forum speculation?

**refuted=true** if: unsupported by quote / contradicted / low-quality source for strong claim / outdated / marketing fluff.
**refuted=false** ONLY if: claim is well-supported, current, and source quality matches claim strength.
Default to refuted=true if uncertain.

Structured output only. Evidence MUST be specific.

# GLM-5 Paper Summary

**Title:** GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

**Authors/Organization:** GLM-5-Team from multiple institutions, including Aohan Zeng, Minlie Huang, Jie Tang, and 184+ additional contributors

**Submission Date:** February 17, 2026 (v1); February 24, 2026 (v2)

**Abstract Contains Target Phrases:** Yes

The abstract explicitly states: "We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering."

The abstract also references these concepts again: "Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor"

Web search results for query: "GLM-5 Zhipu "vibe coding" "agentic engineering" paradigm"

Links: [{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - ar5iv - arXiv","url":"https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering GLM-5 Team","url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://arxiv.org/html/2602.15763v1"},{"title":"GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering | Papers | HyperAI","url":"https://beta.hyper.ai/en/papers/2602.15763"},{"title":"[2602.15763] GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15763"},{"title":"GLM-5’s Journey into Agentic Engineering | by Miles K. | Jun, 2026 | Medium","url":"https://medium.com/@milesk_33/glm-5s-journey-into-agentic-engineering-ed8526fd2dd7"},{"title":"(PDF) GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://www.researchgate.net/publication/400895075_GLM-5_from_Vibe_Coding_to_Agentic_Engineering"},{"title":"GLM-5: Frontier Leap of Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - Webkul Blog","url":"https://webkul.com/blog/glm-5/"},{"title":"Paper page - GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering","url":"https://huggingface.co/papers/2602.15763"},{"title":"GitHub - zai-org/GLM-5: GLM-5: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering · GitHub","url":"https://github.com/zai-org/GLM-5"}]

Based on the search results, here's what I found about GLM-5, Zhipu's "vibe coding" to "agentic engineering" paradigm:

## Overview

GLM-5 is a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering, developed by Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University. Zhipu AI announced GLM-5 on February 11, 2026.

## Key Technical Features

GLM-5 is a 744-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model. Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor, GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity.

To advance model alignment and autonomy, GLM-5 implements a new asynchronous reinforcement learning infrastructure that drastically improves post-training efficiency by decoupling generation from training. The model proposes novel asynchronous agent RL algorithms that further improve RL quality, enabling the model to learn from complex, long-horizon interactions more effectively.

## The Paradigm Shift

The distinction between "vibe coding" and "agentic engineering" is significant: one is a tool, the other a partner. The previous models were good at quick and creative vibe-based coding, while GLM-5 focuses on long-standing and reliable agents.

## Performance

GLM-5 achieves state-of-the-art performance on major open benchmarks, and demonstrates unprecedented capability in real-world coding tasks, surpassing previous baselines in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

input.evidence: The claim survives adversarial checking. (1) Quote support: the phrase is not cherry-picked from a body paragraph — it is the paper's actual title, "GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering" (arXiv:2602.15763, GLM-5 Team, submitted 2026-02-17, v2 2026-02-24), and the abstract verbatim states "We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering." (2) The interpretive gloss ("autonomous end-to-end software engineering rather than interactive assisted coding") is directly backed by the same abstract, which says GLM-5 "demonstrates unprecedented capability ... in handling end-to-end software engineering challenges." (3) Attribution to Zhipu/Z.ai is correct: the official repo is github.com/zai-org/GLM-5 with the same title, and the GLM-5 Team includes Zhipu-affiliated authors (Aohan Zeng, Jie Tang). (4) Currency: Feb 2026 announcement/paper, GLM-5 remains Zhipu's flagship as of July 2026 — not outdated. (5) Marketing caveat considered and rejected as grounds for refutation: the claim asserts only how Zhipu *frames* the model (a framing/positioning claim), for which the lab's own primary technical report is exactly the right source; the claim does not assert the framing is objectively achieved. No contradicting sources found; independent coverage (HuggingFace papers page, third-party blogs) repeats the same framing.
